latest.title: Commensurability Relations Between Deligne-Mostow-Thurston and Ghazouani-Pirio Monodromy Groups
latest.abstract: We classify commensurability relations between Deligne--Mostow--Thurston monodromy groups and the sixteen arithmetic Ghazouani--Pirio monodromy groups arising from moduli of flat cone metrics on the sphere and on the torus. In both settings, the monodromy group preserves a skew-Hermitian form coming from twisted homology. We use a degeneration method to compute their determinant classes in the genus one case. The defining CM fields and determinant classes of the skew-Hermitian forms determine the commensurability relations. In particular, each of the sixteen arithmetic Ghazouani--Pirio monodromy groups is commensurable with an arithmetic Deligne--Mostow--Thurston monodromy group.

latest.breakthrough: 证明这十六个群均与相应算术 DMT 群公度。
latest.limitations: 是指定算术群清单，不包括所有非算术 monodromy。 当前为摘要级分析，方法及结论须回查原文。
